name: -6 AN to 1/4" NPT Male 90 Degree Swivel Adapter
title: -6 AN to 1/4" NPT Male 90 Degree Swivel Adapter
description:
The -6 AN to 1/4" NPT Male 90 Degree Swivel Adapter is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings AN to NPT Male 90 Degree Swivel Adapter Fittings are precision CNC-machined to connect 37-degree AN hose ends to NPT threaded ports while providing a compact 90-degree routing solution. The swivel design allows for easy clocking and precise alignment, making these adapters ideal for fuel, oil, coolant, boost, transmission, and power steering systems where space is limited.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: Premium high-grade construction with corrosion-resistant coating.
• Flow Configuration: 90° mandrel-bent profile for high velocity in tight engine bays.
• Thread Pitch: Precision NPT tapered threads for leak-free sealing in blocks and cells.
